title: Well detailed
body: Everything worked smoothly and this is one of the best planner I’ve ever used
author: Eghele Peter Ighato

title: Opinião da App
body:
Sou um cliente recente e estou a gostar bastante da aplicação! 
1• fazem perguntas bastante importantes e nota-se que estão preocupados connosco (com os cliente)
2• falam sobre termos técnicos e mostram provas do seu conhecimento! 
3• dão resultados excitantes
4•fornecem ferramentas para escolhermos como queremos progredir na app (mind movies, diário, meditações guiadas que é o meu favorito) 
5• temos um teste gratuito durante 7 dias e mesmo que não queiramos fazer a compra, a aplicação gratuita é mesmo boa!! 
6•comparando à concorrência, esta app tem um valor bastante acessível para o plano excelente e ajuda que se tem na aplicação 
7• descontos interessantes
8•fornecem cursos (algo que não existe noutras apps) onde aprendemos com especialistas 
9•conseguimos criar hábitos para adicionar ao rastreador e conseguimos ver a conclusão dos hábitos % por semana 
10• vou usar esta aplicação durante muitos anos !
author: Vantagens!!!

title: Easy to track habits and organize a routine
body: The app has a very intuitive interface, though it could benefit from lighter colours and sharper design. The initial set up can be a little long if you don't want to spend too long in your first time on the app, but overall the experience is good and the app is very useful if you really want to make some changes in your life.
author: emersonreviews

title: Boa primeira impressão
body: Interface organizada e fácil de entender. Ainda estou testando mais funções, mas a primeira impressão foi boa.
author: Jessyelf

title: The first habit app that works for me.
body: I’ve tried so many habit apps, but this is the first one that really helps me understand why I procrastinate. The follow-up questions are smart, and it feels like the app understands my personality before suggesting a routine. It’s helped me build confidence because the advice feels personal and fits how I work. If you want to improve your focus and mood while actually sticking to your goals, this is the one.
author: Gbemme

title: Clean, simple and useful app
body:
I started using Ultiself recently and my first impression is quite good.
The app is simple and easy to use, which makes it easy to get started.
I’ve always struggled to build habits and stay consistent.
I’ve tried different things before but never really stuck with them.
Now I feel more motivated, and I think this app can genuinely help me stay on track

title: Pretty good so far
body: I started using this app to improve my daily habits and routines. I like how I can organize different tasks in one place and check them off throughout the day. The layout is simple and everything is easy to find, which makes it convenient to use regularly.

title: Great app for personal growth
body: I found the app very good. It creates an ideal routine based on my goals and suggests effective habits. I can even track my progress daily. It helped me organize my personal development tasks very well. I highly recommend it for anyone looking for more balance, self-awareness, and well-being in an accessible way
